text:
Omar: Heads up  Mercury Integrations (SI) + GCP Marketplace launch next month. Need a lightweight, deterministic co-sell handoff and account mapping rule set.
Leah: Agree. Keep it deterministic so partners can trust routing. Proposed signals: partner_intro tag, marketplace_utm, deal_tier.
Zane: Draft precedence: 1) partner_intro tag + meeting within 14d -> SI owns, 2) marketplace_utm + SI claimed in intake queue within 48h -> SI owns, 3) ARR >= $120k and not in proposal -> SI owns. Else Redwood owns.
Neta: Add protections: if account.named=true or stage in [proposal,contract] -> block automatic reassignment. Also TTL: partner_intro expires after 21d of no activity.
Leah: Dispute flow idea: claimant files `dispute:open` -> ops-bot posts to #partnerships-disputes -> 24h SLA to respond -> escalate to PM + Sales if unresolved. Log resolution in CRM chatter.
ops-bot: automation note  will set CRM fields `co_sell_owner`, `ownership_reason`, `shadow_owner`, `dispute_state` and post disputes to #partnerships-disputes. :robot_face:
Zane: Pseudocode for intake engine:
```
if has_tag('partner:mercury-intro') and meeting_with_partner_within(14d): owner = Mercury
else if utm_source == 'gcp_marketplace' and partner_claimed == true: owner = Mercury
else if ARR >= 120000 and not in_stage('proposal','contract'): owner = Mercury
else: owner = Redwood
```
Omar: SFDC fields to add: `partner_claimed_by`, `ownership_reason`, `co_sell_owner`, `shadow_ops_owner`, `claim_expires_at`, `dispute_state`. Ops to own playbook.
Leah: Timeline: intake API + SFDC mapping by Wed, automation in staging by Fri, playbook draft by EOD Fri. Pilot for 2 weeks.
Neta: I will own partner comms and the intro email template that auto-adds `partner:mercury-intro`.
Omar: Locking rules unless objections. Anyone?
Zane: No objections from eng.
Leah: All good.
Neta: Good to pilot.
Omar: Thanks  will add playbook link when ready.
